text:
Asha: Heads-up — post-launch we got feedback that interviewer scorecards are inconsistent across hiring lanes (PM vs Eng). Some interviewers mark 'communication' as pass/fail, others use 1-5. We need a short calibration doc and a quick sync.

Ben: Oof. Is this a UI problem (different scorecard templates) or training?

Asha: Both. The templates diverged when someone copied the old PM rubric and edited it. The UI lets teams create custom rubrics so there are 3 slightly different 'communication' fields floating around.

Noah: Can we normalize by enforcing canonical fields for core competencies (communication, problem solving, role knowledge) and allow lane-specific subfields?

Sofia: Agreed. Proposal: create a "Core" section in the scorecard that is mandatory and always shows up regardless of template. Non-core fields can be optional. Also, provide a one-page calibration guide with examples for 1/3/5 ratings.

Asha: Love it. Can InterviewOps-bot help detect existing templates that lack the Core fields?

InterviewOps-bot: [actionable] scanning 42 templates for missing core fields. Report ready: https://internal/reports/1923456789/templates-missing-core.csv. Found 7 templates without Core.communication.

Ben: Nice. Action items: 1) Noah + Eng to update scorecard service to inject Core section by default (feature-flag rollout). 2) Sofia to draft 1-page calibration guide + 3 annotated examples per competency. 3) Asha to schedule two 30-min calibration clinics (one for Eng, one for PM). 4) Ops-bot to run nightly template scan and post to #people-ops for 3 days.

Noah: I'll scope the change: add a migration that updates template schema and a toggle to opt-out for legacy teams. Will add metrics to track how many templates were migrated. ETA: PR by Wednesday.

Sofia: Drafting the guide now. Quick question: do we want the guide to include sample language interviewers can use during feedback? (e.g., "Candidate clearly explained tradeoffs" vs "Lacked clarity").

Asha: Yes please — include sentence starters and an example of a neutral-to-positive framing for borderline hires. Also include calibration rubric for internal calibration sessions (how to discuss disagreements).

Ben: For the clinics, can we do 9am PT slots and record them? Keep them under 45 mins. I can help run the Eng one.

InterviewOps-bot: [note] scheduled nightly scans starting tonight. First report will be posted at 2025-11-02T07:00:00Z.

Asha: Great. Please also add a short banner in the interviewer invite emails linking to the guide so interviewers see it before the loop.

Noah: Will add hooks to the invite service to insert a link when template has 'Core' fields.

Sofia: I'll attach the first draft here by EOD and will add three concrete examples (engineer backend, pm product spec, eng manager leadership).

Asha: Summary of owners: Noah (service migration + opt-out toggle), Sofia (guide + sample language), Ben (run eng clinic), Asha (scheduling + comms), Ops-bot (nightly scans). We'll reconvene after the first clinic to review template migration status. Thanks! :handshake:
